title: improvement: add cast-safety helper macro for size_t→word32 downcasts
description: Three backends (soft, wolfhsm, keystore) each duplicate the pattern: check size_t against UINT32_MAX, return error, then cast. The soft backend does this consistently; wolfhsm and keystore are missing some checks. Introduce a shared helper or macro (e.g., SAFE_U32(sz, err_label)) in wp11_backend.h or a new wp11_util.h so the invariant is explicit and contributors cannot miss a check. All three backends should be converted to use it. Comment at definition site: 'wolfCrypt APIs use word32 (uint32_t); size_t args from PKCS11 callers can be 64-bit. Every downcast must go through this macro.'
